summary: Date.prototype.toJSON is generic: it ToPrimitives this with number hint, returns null for a non-finite Number primitive, otherwise dynamically invokes this.toISOString().

target.notes: Reuse canonical ToPrimitive and dynamic property Invoke/call semantics; a fixed call to JsDate.ToISOString would be incorrect for generic receivers.

semantics.key_argument: ignored by algorithm after ordinary call evaluation

caveats: The receiver need not be a Date object. User valueOf/@@toPrimitive/toISOString hooks are observable.

tests.name: custom toISOString is invoked for generic receiver
